corrections.reason: The printed glyph in the image has the right-side horizontal stroke of the 2nd order 'ሁ' (ሁነው), preserving the authentic archaic Andemta form.

Both visually (6th order 'ስ' with top-left bend) and philologically (the Amharic proverb 'ስብ ሊያርዱ ጉፋያን ይነዱ' — 'when about to slaughter a fat animal, they drive away the lean/chaff'), the printed word is 'ስብ'.
